description.narrative: Niue High School celebrates World Teachers Day, a UN commemoration day to celebrate teachers and the important roles they play in society. This is observed on October 5th every year and the school organise programs and events for the day. Events can include professional development opportunities, awareness programs and community outreach programs to promote what teachers do, fun activities and games, and more serious acknowledgements of the importance of teachers to society. This year is extra special in that Niue will be celebrating 50 years of self-governing in free association with NZ. The Teacher Day celebrations will coincide with this national milestone. The focus this year is on "Empowering Educators: Strengthening Resilience, Building Sustainability." In these challenging times, teachers have emerged as beacons of resilience, adapting and innovating for their students. The project seeks funds to finance Niue High School’s observance of World Teachers Day 2024.
